release_name: Promote beta to production: new Mass, coordinate audit, expanded help
notes: Promotes mauritius-mass-finder-beta v27.5.5 to production, covering everything since v27.5.0. (1) One missing Mass added: Notre-Dame-des-Victoires, Midlands - Saturday 17:30, third Saturday of the month only, a chapel of the Sainte-Therese-d'Avila parish that has its own diocese page but had no row here. Corpus is now 414 rows / 117 sites. (2) Full coordinate audit of all 117 churches against OpenStreetMap, in two passes, correcting ten. Two were genuinely wrong: Sacre-Coeur Beau-Bassin was pinned on the Montmartre chapel in Rose-Hill - a different church already in this corpus - and moved 1.54 km onto its own building; Notre-Dame-de-la-Delivrande was at Cap Malheureux, 20 km from its stated town, and moved 18.6 km to the village of Notre Dame that the diocese page names. Eight more were moved from the village centre onto the mapped church building. Churches shown with an exact location rise from 17 to 25 of 117. No schedule data was changed by the audit. (3) Help expanded from 8 sections to 10 in both languages, explaining feast-day warnings and the diocese document link, Masses that only happen on certain dates (22 rows carry such a rule), and what 'Batch reconciled' and 'Lower confidence - check source' actually mean. (4) A row with no coordinate no longer claims 'Approx. location'; it says nothing instead.
